, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there lived a small bug. The bug had a friend, a bird. They liked to play together.
One day, the bird could not find his toy. The bug wanted to help his friend. So, they looked all around the mountain. They looked under rocks, in trees, and even in the river. They could not find the toy.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her soft toy cat. She would squeeze it and hug it all the time. Lucy and her toy cat were best friends.
One day, Lucy went to the park with her mom and her toy cat. She played in the sun and had lots of fun. But when it was time to go home, Lucy forgot to take her toy cat with her. She left it on the ground near the swings.
A little boy named Tim saw the toy cat and picked it up. He was very careful not to drop it. He held it tight and saw that it was his favorite toy. Tim thought it was a cute toy and he wanted to keep it too. So, he put the toy cat in his pocket to keep it safe.
Lucy's mom called her on the phone. "Lucy, it's time to go home!" she said. Lucy looked sad, but she knew she had to go. She gave her toy cat a big hug and said goodbye. Tim felt bad for taking Lucy's toy cat without asking. He learned that it is important to always ask before touching other people's belongings.
